### [657] [LocAttMamba: A Low-Complexity Mamba Framework with Attention-Based Multi-AP Fusion for Indoor Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05673)
*MohammadMahdi Ghadaksaz,Mohammad Farzanullah,Melike Erol-Kantarci*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出LocAttMamba，一种低复杂度室内定位框架，用近线性复杂度的Mamba编码器处理各AP的CIR与时序特征，再经多头注意力融合，联合预测位置与逐轴不确定性，在5G和UWB数据集上取得最优精度与更低计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G/6G中定位设备算力受限且常处于非视距(NLoS)场景，传统信号级方法在NLoS下性能退化；Transformer能捕捉AP测量间依赖，但计算复杂度高、推理慢；轻量RNN/CNN虽快却精度下降。因此需要兼顾低复杂度与高精度的定位方案。

Method: LocAttMamba：对每个AP的信道冲激响应(CIR)和时间特征分别用独立的Mamba编码器处理（近线性复杂度），得到逐AP嵌入；再用多头注意力层按每个时刻各AP的重要性加权融合；框架联合预测用户位置及其逐轴不确定性，并通过事后校准步骤对不确定性进行精修。

Result: 在两个真实5G和UWB测量数据集上评估：平均二维定位误差分别为1.004 m和0.599 m，比次优基准分别提升9.79%和5.82%；在所有评估模型中乘累加运算量最少，且比基于Transformer的基准快4.4–16倍。

Conclusion: LocAttMamba在保持最低计算开销的同时实现了优于Transformer等基准的定位精度与更快的推理速度，验证了Mamba结合注意力融合在算力受限、NLoS环境下的室内定位有效性。

Abstract: Accurate and low-complexity indoor localization is important for location-based services in fifth generation (5G) and sixth generation (6G) networks, where positioning devices operate under limited computational budgets and non conditions. Indoor localization has been studied widely using traditional signal-level localization approaches. However, these techniques often show degraded performance in on-line-of-sight (NLoS) scenarios. Recently, artificial intelligence (AI)-based techniques, including transformers, have been applied to address these challenges. While transformer-based architectures can capture the dependencies within the measurements collected from distributed access points (APs), their high computational complexity results in a large number of multiply-accumulate operations and long inference time. In contrast, lightweight recurrent and convolutional models trade this cost for degraded accuracy. In this paper, we propose LocAttMamba, a low-complexity localization framework in which the channel impulse response (CIR) and time-based features of each AP are processed by a separate Mamba encoder with near-linear complexity, and the resulting per-AP embeddings are fused through a multi-head attention layer that weights each AP according to its importance at every time step. The framework jointly predicts the user location and its per-axis uncertainty, which is refined through a post-hoc calibration step. We evaluate the proposed framework using two real-world 5G and ultra-wideband (UWB) measurement datasets. Our numerical results reveal that LocAttMamba obtains a mean two-dimensional (2-D) positioning error of 1.004 m and 0.599 m, respectively, on 5G and UWB datasets, outperforming the second-best benchmark by 9.79% and 5.82%, while requiring the fewest multiply-accumulate operations among all evaluated models and being 4.4-16 times faster than the transformer-based benchmarks.

</details>


### [658] [6G as It Is Actually Being Built: Insights from Early 3GPP Standardization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05694)
*Ngo Hoang Tu,Huy T. Nguyen,Mao V. Ngo,Tran Thien Thanh,Vo Nguyen Quoc Bao,Tony Q. S. Quek*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文综述3GPP 6G标准化进展（Release-20研究阶段与Release-21首个规范时间表），梳理服务需求、系统架构、无线接口、原生AI、ISAC、NTN及核心网协议，并提炼七条跨领域经验教训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动通信从5G迈向6G，3GPP已进入决定性阶段；作者不提供技术愿景或编年史，而是追问"首批已达成的6G共识材料"究竟揭示了什么。

Method: 跨RAN、SA、CT三大TSG审阅既定6G材料，追踪各议题从研究项走向规范的路径；对每条引述材料标注统一快照日期的成熟状态（已批准、草案、个人提案、厂商演示），并将结论明确为作者综合判断而非3GPP官方立场。

Result: 提炼出七条跨领域经验：AI已从一项功能演变为贯穿各阶段的基本原语；非地面接入从叠加层转变为基础层；连接性现为计算与感知三者并列的目标之一；产业界偏好可部署性而非重新设计，频谱获取与站点复用比波形创新更具约束力；标准化瞄准AI工作流而非AI模型，跨厂商可测试性成为技术存留的关键判据。

Conclusion: 文章展望2030年前后的试验与商用启动，并指出上述经验有助于确定优先解决的开放问题。

Abstract: As mobile communications cross the threshold from 5G to 6G, the 3GPP has entered a decisive phase. Following the Technical Specification Group (TSG) plenary meetings of June 2026 and the associated 6G workshop in Singapore, the Release-20 study phase is now well underway across all three TSGs: Radio Access Network (RAN), Service and System Aspects (SA), and Core Network and Terminals (CT). Concurrently, the timeline for the first normative 6G specifications in Release 21 has been established. Rather than offering another technology vision, or a chronological account of committee progress, this article asks what the first body of agreed 6G material tells us. We review service requirements, system architecture, the emerging radio interface, native AI, ISAC, non-terrestrial networks (NTN), and core-network protocols, tracing how each moves from study item toward specification. Read across the three TSGs, this material also supports seven cross-cutting lessons: AI has moved from a feature to a primitive spanning every stage, non-terrestrial access has crossed from overlay to substrate, and connectivity is now one objective among three alongside computing and sensing; the industry favors deployability over redesign, with spectrum access and site reuse, rather than waveform innovation, appearing to be the tighter constraint; and standardization targets AI workflows rather than AI models, with testability across vendors recurring as a decisive criterion for which techniques survive. Because the material spans very different stages of maturity, every item cited is tagged with its status at a single snapshot date (approved, draft, individually proposed, or vendor-demonstrated), and the lessons are offered as the authors' synthesis rather than as 3GPP positions. We close with the road toward trials and commercial launch around 2030, and with the open questions these lessons help prioritize.

</details>


### [659] [Implementation of Zero-shot Semantic Communication on Software Defined Radio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05764)
*Thanh Le,Arif Dataesatu,Homare Murakami,Takeshi Matsumura*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 该论文在软件定义无线电平台上实现了零样本语义通信，验证了相比传统JPEG+16QAM基线可减少9倍信道使用并在CIFAR-10和TSRD上取得高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本语义通信的优势目前多停留在数值仿真阶段，缺乏真实硬件平台验证。作者希望在软件定义无线电平台上实现并评估其实际性能。

Method: 使用树莓派驱动ADALM-Pluto收发器对，发送端部署图像编码器、接收端部署文本编码器，通过余弦相似度进行零样本分类。对比CLIP与MobileCLIP在不同信噪比下的表现，并将图像编码器卸载到神经处理单元。

Result: 语义链路每张图像信道使用比JPEG+16QAM基线少9倍；22.3 dB下CIFAR-10准确率82%（基线0%），TSRD上MobileCLIP对未见图像分类准确率98.3%。NPU卸载使编码降至每张13.4 ms，比树莓派4 CPU快49倍。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在真实SDR平台上验证了零样本语义通信的可行性与效率优势，且通过NPU卸载满足实时预算，代码已开源。

Abstract: Semantic communication has recently gained traction for its ability to reduce the amount of data transmitted over a communication link by transmitting a task-oriented representation instead of the raw source. Zero-shot semantic communication sends a general embedding from a vision-language model (VLM), so the same transmitter can serve new classification tasks without retraining. Most evidence for this advantage, however, comes from numerical simulation. We implement zero-shot semantic communication on a software-defined radio platform: a Raspberry Pi drives a pair of Analog Devices Active Learning Module (ADALM)-Pluto transceivers, with an image encoder at the transmitter and a text encoder at the receiver, and determines the zero-shot classification results via cosine similarity. We compare two VLMs, CLIP and MobileCLIP, across various channel conditions, i.e., different signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs). We validate that the semantic link spends 9x fewer channel uses per image than a JPEG plus 16-ary quadrature amplitude modulation baseline and still reaches 82% accuracy on CIFAR-10 at 22.3 dB, where the baseline scores 0%. On the traffic sign recognition dataset (TSRD), MobileCLIP correctly classifies 98.3% of unseen images at the same SNR. Offloading the image encoder to a neural processing unit reduces encoding to 13.4 ms per image, 49x faster than a Raspberry Pi 4 CPU, placing the transmitter within a real-time budget. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/thanhlexyz/zsscsdr.

</details>


### [660] [Generative-AI for XR Content Transmission in the Metaverse: Potential Approaches, Challenges, and a Generation-Driven Transmission Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05888)
*Zhe Zhang,Yili Jiang,Xin Wei,Mingkai Chen,Haiwei Dong,Shui Yu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文针对元宇宙中XR内容传输的网络瓶颈，提出基于生成式AI（GAI）与云边协同架构的传输框架，用DRL做决策，实验显示正常帧率较基线提升2.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XR内容体量大，现有网络难以高效传输，成为实现元宇宙的主要瓶颈，亟需新的传输方案。

Method: 提出GAI驱动的XR内容传输框架：云服务器存储并渲染原始XR内容，边缘服务器在网络资源不足时用GAI模型生成关键内容（如后续帧、选定对象）；并引入基于深度强化学习（DRL）的决策模块解决决策问题。

Result: 案例研究表明，所提框架的无故障（正常）帧率较基线方法提升2.8倍。

Conclusion: GAI模型在促进元宇宙中XR内容传输方面具有显著潜力。

Abstract: How to efficiently transmit large volumes of Extended Reality (XR) content through current networks has been a major bottleneck in realizing the Metaverse. The recently emerging Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) has already revolutionized various technological fields and provides promising solutions to this challenge. In this article, we first demonstrate current networks' bottlenecks for supporting XR content transmission in the Metaverse. Then, we explore the potential approaches and challenges of utilizing GAI to overcome these bottlenecks. To address these challenges, we propose a GAI-based XR content transmission framework which leverages a cloud-edge collaboration architecture. The cloud servers are responsible for storing and rendering the original XR content, while edge servers utilize GAI models to generate essential parts of XR content (e.g., subsequent frames, selected objects, etc.) when network resources are insufficient to transmit them. A Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based decision module is proposed to solve the decision-making problems. Our case study demonstrates that the proposed GAI-based transmission framework achieves a 2.8-fold increase in normal frame ratio (percentage of frames that meet the quality and latency requirements for XR content transmission) over baseline approaches, underscoring the potential of GAI models to facilitate XR content transmission in the Metaverse.

</details>


### [661] [Identification Codes for Ad Hoc Networks: Use Cases and Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06123)
*Athin Mohan,Roberto Ferrara,Christian Deppe*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究高节点密度的大规模自组网中，通过在MAC层地址字段使用ID码来缩减包头、减少数据传输量，从而实现节能，并探讨其用例、挑战及对路由机制的适配设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模高密度自组网中，节点数据传输量大会带来较高的能量消耗，需尽量减少发送的总比特数及相应能耗。

Method: 在MAC层地址字段采用ID码以缩短包头尺寸，并将其融入自组网的数据包路由机制，结合多种用例与挑战进行分析。

Result: 展示了将ID码引入包路由机制的收益，为理解其适用性与所需设计适配奠定基础（摘要未给出定量结果）。

Conclusion: 在MAC层使用ID码是提升大规模高密度自组网能效的可行方向，但需针对路由机制做相应设计适配。

Abstract: In this study, we focus on large-scale ad hoc networks characterized by a high node density. To achieve energy efficiency, the devices must minimize their data transmission, thereby reducing the total number of bits sent and the associated energy consumption. We consider using ID codes for the address field in the MAC layer and reduce the header size. The work explores a range of use cases and challenges that demonstrate the benefits of incorporating these ID codes into packet routing mechanisms for ad hoc networks, thereby providing a foundation for understanding their applicability and the necessary design adaptations.

</details>


### [662] [Explicit QUIC Proxies for Server-Side Geo-blocking Bypass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06179)
*Aurélien Buchet,Soyong Kim,Tom Barbette,Cristel Pelsser*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 论文提出Stork，一种HTTP/2到HTTP/3代理，利用QUIC连接迁移在请求头发出后绕过服务器端的Geo-block，显著降低规避成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理限制内容普遍，用户依赖VPN等规避手段，但成本高且性能差。QUIC允许连接在路径间迁移，为绕过限制提供了新机会。

Method: 扫描Web服务器发现多数Geo-block在应用层、请求到达时仅检查一次。据此设计Stork：客户端从白名单IP发出请求，服务器接受后将连接迁移到未授权地址（post-header migration），实现直接传输。

Result: Stork兼容主流客户端和服务器。2MB请求实验中迁移99%数据；真实目标中52%以上可迁移至少75%数据；真实Geo-block内容下90%域绕过成功，而post-handshake仅60%。

Conclusion: post-header migration能有效绕过Geo-block并最大化直连流量，Stork以可忽略延迟实现高成功率规避，优于以往方法。

Abstract: Geo-restricted content is increasingly common on the Internet, forcing users to rely on circumvention techniques, such as VPNs, to access the web from a seemingly different location. However, these often come with a financial cost and can degrade performance. The rise in popularity of the QUIC protocol, which allows connections to migrate between paths, opens opportunities to circumvent such restrictions. We scan web servers and find that a large portion of geo- blocked content is enforced on the server, at the application layer, rather than on-path. This check is performed once, when the request arrives, and is not repeated as the connection continues. This allows a client to issue its request from a whitelisted IP address and, once the server has accepted it, migrate the connection to an otherwise unauthorized address for the rest of the transfer (post-header migration). It bypasses the block while maximizing direct traffic, thereby reducing eventual circumvention-related costs. Building on this insight, we introduce Stork, an HTTP/2-to-HTTP/3 web proxy that bypasses geo-blocking while introducing negligible additional latency. We demonstrate that our solution is compatible with popular clients and servers. In controlled experiments with 2 MB requests, our proxy migrates 99% of the transferred data onto the unauthorized path. Across real-world targets that support QUIC migration, it migrates at least 75% of the data for more than 52% of them. On real geo-blocked content, post-header migration bypasses the block for 90% of domains, whereas post-handshake migration, as used by prior work, succeeds for only 60%.

</details>


### [663] [Graph Neural Network-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Scalable RIS Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06295)
*Martin Mark Zan,Stefan Schwarz*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出GNN+DRL的可扩展框架，用于6G多小区网络中共享RIS的动态编排，通过物理拓扑稀疏化与关系型消息传递实现高效分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS可缓解6G多小区网络中的阻塞并扩展毫米波覆盖，但跨竞争基站的共享RIS基础设施动态分配是NP-hard问题，存在严重可扩展性瓶颈。

Method: 将分配建模为马尔可夫决策过程；提出物理拓扑稀疏化策略，将密集信道矩阵剪枝为稀疏三分图（边密度降低77%）；采用关系型消息传递架构，可无需重训练泛化到任意网络维度；结构消融揭示路径损耗使表面依赖局部化，支持线性计算扩展的局部图设计。

Result: 在密集城市场景中，严格基础设施预算下，GNN-DRL框架覆盖率较贪心启发式基线最高提升约12%，并借助GPU加速实现更快推理。

Conclusion: GNN-DRL框架有效解决共享RIS编排的可扩展性问题，稀疏化与局部化设计兼顾覆盖提升与计算效率。

Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RISs) offer a promising paradigm to mitigate blockage and extend millimeter-wave coverage in 6G multi-cell networks. However, dynamically allocating shared RIS infrastructure across competing base stations is an NP-hard problem posing severe scalability bottlenecks. In this paper, we propose a scalable framework combining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for dynamic shared RIS orchestration. By formulating allocation as a Markov Decision Process, we introduce a physical topology sparsification strategy that prunes dense channel matrices into a sparse tripartite graph. This pruning reduces edge density by 77% and removes representation noise, thereby improving global coverage probability while reducing computational complexity. Our relational message-passing architecture naturally generalizes to arbitrary network dimensions without model retraining. Furthermore, structural ablation studies reveal that physical path loss localizes surface dependencies, enabling a highly efficient localized graph design with linear computational scaling. Extensive simulations in dense urban environments demonstrate that under strict infrastructure budget constraints, the proposed GNN-DRL framework consistently outperforms greedy heuristic baselines by up to ~12% in coverage while delivering faster inference speed via GPU acceleration.

</details>


### [664] [SoK: Semantic Decision Engines in Network Control Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06425)
*Delong Li,Chen Li,Xu Wang,Haochen Gong,Rui Lang,Guangsheng Yu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文系统化分析了139个语义决策引擎(如Jev)研究族，揭示其在控制回路中缺乏截止时间、可行性和覆盖验证的严重报告缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义决策引擎即便返回有效答案，仍可能错过网络截止时间、选择不可行动作或使服务未经覆盖验证。作者希望厘清决策接口、执行路径与检查归属，识别现有研究在将决策引擎接入控制回路时的报告缺失。

Method: 按决策接口、执行路径和检查归属对139个研究族进行系统化分类，并比较其关于控制回路/时间预算的声明与实际测量证据；针对无确定性计算步骤的72个族做有界测试，考察事件模型、排队与覆盖检查的影响。

Result: 50个族声称引擎适配控制回路或时间预算，仅4个有匹配测量支撑；全部139个中仅4个报告截止时间达成。缺口集中在无确定性计算步骤的决策：72个族提出22项声明，无一被支撑，仅2个指明覆盖归属方。有界测试显示每个缺口都可能反转准入判定——单请求满足10秒预算的引擎，在决策排队后无一满足；同一引擎可通过对一种覆盖检查而失败于另一种。

Conclusion: 论文提出最小报告记录、设计规则与研究议程，为将决策引擎准入控制回路提供系统性指导。

Abstract: A semantic decision engine such as Jev can return a valid answer and still miss a network deadline, select an infeasible action or leave the service unverified. We systematize 139 paper families by decision interface, execution path and check ownership. Fifty families claim that their engine fits a control loop or time budget, but only four support the claim with matched measurement. Across all 139, four report deadline attainment. The gap concentrates where the decision has no deterministic computation step. Those 72 families make 22 of the claims, none supported, and name a coverage owner in only two. Bounded tests under one event model show that each gap can reverse an admission verdict. A decision that meets a 10 s budget for every isolated request meets it for none once decisions queue ahead of replayed execution times. The same engine passes one coverage check and fails another. We derive a minimum reporting record, design rules and a research agenda for admitting decision engines to control loops.

</details>

### [665] [Gated Graph Neural Networks for Learning Hidden Independent Cascade Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04033)
*Anubha Goel,Illia Oleksiienko,Mateusz Wilinski,Alexandros Iosifidis,Juho Kanniainen*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 研究隐藏独立级联模型下（每节点一个传播概率）的逆问题，提出基于模拟的摊销估计器 SACF+SAGE-HC，无需重建潜级联即可恢复节点级参数向量，在含环异质图上优于扩展的 DMP 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信息与传染病经社交网络传播，但缺乏每节点激活时间，难以估计传播概率；实际只能依赖间接、含噪的终端感染状态代理，且需逐节点估计参数（未知量随节点数增长），观察似然需对全部传播结果边缘化。

Method: 提出基于模拟的摊销估计器：用重复种子条件下的症状观测构建“症状感知级联特征”（SACF），融合经验症状统计与邻域/结构信息；再用 SAGE-HC——一种置换等变门控图神经网络——将 SACF 映射为参数，通过学习的门控抑制被假阳性/假阴性污染的邻域消息，在模拟 HIC 实现上训练得到可复用的逆映射。同时将动态消息传递（DMP）学习框架扩展到 HIC 发射模型作为基准。

Result: 在合成与真实图上两方法按拓扑分离：DMP 在树上高度准确，而 SAGE-HC 在含噪终端症状下、异质含环图上明显更优。

Conclusion: 两种方法各有所长、按图拓扑互补；SAGE-HC 更适合含环异质图与噪声终端观测场景，为无激活时间条件下的节点级传播参数推断提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Information and infectious diseases spread through social networks, but the spreading probabilities driving them are hard to estimate without per-node activation times. Applications seldom supply these, and inference must instead proceed through indirect and noisy proxies for the terminal infection states. We study this inverse problem on a fixed, known graph under the Hidden Independent Cascade (HIC) model, with one spreading probability per node rather than a single global rate, so the number of unknowns scales with the number of nodes. Seed sets and observation parameters are known, while activation times and terminal infection states are latent, and the observed-data likelihood requires marginalizing over every spreading outcome. We propose a simulation-based amortized estimator that recovers the full node-level parameter vector without reconstructing individual latent cascades. Repeated seed-conditioned symptom observations are summarized as Symptom-Aware Cascade Features (SACF), which combine empirical symptom statistics with neighborhood and structural information. SACF are mapped to parameters by SAGE-HC, a permutation-equivariant gated graph neural network whose learned gates attenuate neighborhood messages corrupted by false positives and false negatives, and training on simulated HIC realizations yields a reusable inverse map. As a benchmark under the same hidden observations, we extend the Dynamic Message Passing learning framework to the HIC emission model. On synthetic and empirical graphs the two methods separate by topology. DMP is highly accurate on trees, whereas SAGE-HC is substantially better on heterogeneous, loopy graphs under noisy terminal symptoms.

</details>


### [666] [Exact computation of the network modularity with branch-and-bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04668)
*Emily Weng,Georg Hahn*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分支定界算法，用于精确计算网络模块度（最大化模块度的最优聚类），通过边界剪枝避免穷举搜索，并与暴力法、模拟退火和Louvain方法进行比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络模块度是衡量网络/图结构（划分成模块或聚类）的常用指标，但其精确计算是NP难问题，实际中往往不可行，因此文献中多采用启发式方法。本文旨在实现精确且高效的最优聚类计算。

Method: 采用分支定界算法精确计算网络模块度。通过对部分解进行边界估计，一旦预见某部分解无法超越已有解便将其剪枝，从而在不完全搜索整个解空间的情况下保证找到最大化模块度的最优聚类。

Result: 从准确性和运行时间两方面评估算法，并与暴力穷举法以及两种最先进基准方法（模拟退火和Louvain方法）进行比较。

Conclusion: 所提出的分支定界算法能够保证找到最大化网络模块度的最优聚类，同时通过剪枝避免完整搜索，具有准确性和效率上的优势。

Abstract: We consider the computation of the network modularity, a common measure of the structure of networks or graphs that quantifies the division of a network into modules or clusters. The computation of the network modularity is an NP-hard problem, thus making its exact computation often infeasible in practice. This has resulted in the development of several heuristics in the literature. In this work, we consider the exact computation of the network modularity with the help of a branch-and-bound algorithm. Our algorithm is guaranteed to find the optimal clustering that maximizes the network modularity, however it achieves this without a full exploration of the search space. This is accomplished by bounding partial solutions and discarding them if it can be foreseen that a partial solution will not yield an improvement over an existing solution. We assess our algorithm with respect to accuracy and runtime and compare it to a brute-force approach as well as two state-of-the-art benchmarks, simulated annealing and the Louvain method.

</details>


### [667] [Predicting Engagement with Sponsored Content Across Account Types on Instagram](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06164)
*Pedro Victor de Sousa Lima,Olga Goussevskaia*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文构建了包含1500万条赞助Instagram帖子的大规模数据集，通过可解释的统计与回归模型预测用户互动，发现按实体类型或受众层级细分后预测效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究用户如何与社交媒体平台上的赞助内容互动，并在保证透明度的前提下，用可解释方法而非深度学习来预测互动。

Method: 收集并分析大规模赞助Instagram帖子数据集；对账号按受众规模和实体类型等多维度分类；从帖文标题和话题标签中提取语义特征；用这些特征训练回归模型预测互动。

Result: 在超过1500万条帖子、70万+账号的数据集上验证，模型预测能力具竞争力，且完全透明地揭示驱动互动的特征；按实体类型或受众层级细分后，互动预测更准确且高度优化。

Conclusion: 每条帖子的互动部分可预测，用透明的可解释模型在细分账号后能达到有竞争力的预测效果。

Abstract: In this work we explore how users interact with sponsored content on social media platforms by collecting and analyzing a large-scale dataset of sponsored Instagram posts. To maintain transparency, we favor robust statistical analysis and explainable models over deep learning techniques. Our pipeline categorizes Instagram accounts along multiple dimensions, including audience size and entity type. We complement this with semantic features extracted from post captions and hashtags, and use these elements to train regression models that forecast engagement. We validate our approach on a dataset comprising over 15M Instagram posts authored by over 700K accounts featuring sponsored content. Our analysis shows that per-post engagement is partly predictable and highly optimized when accounts are segmented by entity type or audience tier. Our models achieve competitive predictive power, while remaining fully transparent about which features drive engagement.

</details>
